clips.title: The story
paras: In Aldrassil, Shanda guides young night elf priests in the ways of Elune. She serves the Sisterhood of Elune in Shadowglen, teaching prayers, wards, and rites as her students prepare to defend Teldrassil.

Shanda guides young night elves devoted to Elune from within Aldrassil. While druids tend Teldrassil's roots and boughs, priestesses keep the Kaldorei close to the White Lady. Shanda teaches new initiates to call on lunar grace for healing and protective wards, preparing them to face the corruption creeping into the World Tree's boughs.

Young priests who awaken to their calling in Shadowglen come to Shanda to prove their devotion and learn their first prayers. Through rites such as In Favor of Elune, she tests their resolve, gives them blessed regalia, and teaches basic incantations. Her students learn to tend the wounded with a gentle hand and stand firm against the shadows.
